description: Election Commission - Declare the names of Chairman, Vice Chairman and a member of the Divulapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government positions (Chairman, Vice Chairman, and Member) of the Divulapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including nominations by political parties and declarations by the Returning Officer, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than general government personnel changes.
